N1.cacheScope: Two immutable local variables per present owner per assemble call; no across-call or persistent cache
N1.canonicalResultSha256: After bounded parse and existing result checks, compute SHA256(canonicalJson(parsed wrapper.result)) once; use same value at every original consumer. This remains a derived digest, never raw wrapper or runtime payload identity.
N1.preservation: No normalization/exclusion/hash fixedpoint, added digest field, result mutation, API, workload or deadline change. No benchmark/actual timeout asserted.
N1.rawWrapperSha256: After intrinsic source byte copy, compute SHA256(bytes) once; use same value for expected hash check, all row projections and owner report summary.

captureOrder: Validate canonical selection and real factory configuration as before.
Intrinsic own-data-capture each observation. Reject wrong primitive identity/hash types before any canonicalJson comparison or regex coercion.

Intrinsically capture arrays and nested ready/session/transport data using existing safeData/ownData/array helpers and existing100000nodes/128depth/10000container limits; reject Proxy/accessor/function/nonfinite values without evaluating behavior.

Only traverse captured plain finite data or bounded parsed JSON. Keep branded configuration reference for its existing factory assertion; compare its immutable own-data representation after brand check.
N3.errors: No new error class/code/cause/input/path echo. Getter/Proxy/function shape refusal invalid-source; missing/malformed parsed report metadata invalid-report; well-formed inconsistent bound configuration/session metadata configuration-mismatch. Existing valid digest mismatch remains invalid-report.

primitiveSlots.expectedReportSha256: primitive lower64hex string; wrong type/grammar invalid-source; well-formed unequal actual raw digest invalid-report
primitiveSlots.lifecycle.cleanup: existing finite enum through primitive text validation, no change
primitiveSlots.ownerId: primitive string exactly expected fixed owner ID; wrong type invalid-source, wrong identity invalid-report
primitiveSlots.runtimeConfigurationIdentity: primitive lower64hex string as current contract; compare all actual baseline/session identities with it, never String(value) coercion
primitiveSlots.sourceCommit: primitive lower40hex string, equal bound configuration.sourceCommit; wrong type invalid-source, valid different source configuration-mismatch
